66501.meaning2: having lived, having abided, having dwelt, having stayed

examples.text: ayācito tat'āgacchi, n'ānuññāto ito gato, kutoci nūna āgantvā, vasitvā katip'āhakaṃ, ito'pi aññena gato, tato'p'aññena gacchati.

anāpatti, chārattaṃ vippavasati, ūnakachārattaṃ vippavasati, chārattaṃ vippavasitvā puna gāmasīmaṃ okkamitvā vasitvā pakkamati, anto chārattaṃ paccuddharati, vissajjeti, nassati, vinassati, ḍayhati, acchinditvā gaṇhanti, vissāsaṃ gaṇhanti, bhikkhusammutiyā, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

ariyassa bhāvit'attassa, pattipattassa veyyākaraṇassa, satimato vipassissa, anabhinatassa no apanatassa, anejassa vasippattassa, bhagavato tassa sāvako'ham'asmi.

ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vasī vitakkapariyāyapathesu.

examples.text: tiṇṇaṃ tesaṃ āvasi'n'ettha eko, gandhabbakāy'ūpagato vasīno, dve ca sambodhipath'ānusārino, deve'pi hīḷenti samāhitattā.

66511.meaning1: subjugated; under one's control; subject to one's authority

examples.text: mano c'assa supaṇihito, (iti sātāgiro yakkho) sabbabhūtesu tādino, atho iṭṭhe aniṭṭhe ca, saṅkappassa vasīkatā.
ehi kāḷa nivattassu, bhuñja kāme yathā pure, ahañ'ca te vasīkatā, ye ca me santi ñātakā.

cittasmiṃ vasībhūta-amhi, iddhipādā subhāvitā, sabbabandhanamutt'āmhi, na taṃ bhāyāmi āvuso'ti.

vasa > vasī + bhūta + tta

nagā samuddā saritā vasun'dharā, disā catasso vidisā adho divā, sabbe aniccā tibhavā upaddutā, kuhiṃ gato citta sukhaṃ ramissasi.

66519.meaning1: filled with wealth; abounding in riches; filled with goodness

examples.text: taḷākaṃ vasupūritaṃ ghammapathe, tividh'aggipiḷesita-nibbāpanaṃ, byādhi-panudana-osadhayo, pacchimasuttapavarā ṭhapitā.

66521.meaning1: name of a group of deities
66521.commentary: (DNa) vasūnaṃ vāsavo seṭṭho, sakk'opāgā purin'dado'ti vasūnaṃ devatānaṃ seṭṭho vāsavo yo sakko'ti ca, purin'dado'ti ca vuccati, so'pi āgato.

examples.text: vasūnaṃ vāsavo seṭṭho, sakk'opāgā purin'dado, das'ete dasadhā kāyā, sabbe nānattavaṇṇino.

66522.meaning1: could live; may stay; could reside

examples.text: kadā nu'haṃ bhayajananiṃ dukh'āvahaṃ, taṇhālataṃ bahuvidh'ānuvattaniṃ, paññāmayaṃ tikhiṇam'asiṃ gahetvā, chetvā vase tam'pi kadā bhavissati.
patirūpe vase dese, ariyamittakaro siyā, sammāpaṇidhisampanno, pubbe puññakato naro, dhaññaṃ dhanaṃ yaso kitti, sukhaṃc'etaṃadhivattatī.

66523.meaning1: is under the control; is under the power; is under the influence (of)

examples.text: tassa kho etaṃ, bho gotama, kāy'anvayaṃ cittaṃ hoti, kāyassa vasena vattati. taṃ kissa hetu? abhāvitattā cittassa.

66524.grammar: ind, adv, in comps, instr sg of vasa (+gen)
66524.notes: (MW) by command of, by force of, on account of, by means of, according to

examples.text: evaṃ utu-ācikkhanaṃ. utūn'īdha pana sāsane hem'anta-gimha-vassānānaṃ vasena tīṇi honti.
n'āhaṃ taṃ pamāṇaṃ atikkamitvā rajjan'ādivasena uppajjituṃ dassāmī'ti evam'ettha attho daṭṭhabbo.

66525.grammar: ind, adv, in comps, instr sg of vasa (+gen)

66526.grammar: ind, adv, in comps, instr sg of vasa (+gen)

examples.text: na kahāpaṇavassena, titti kāmesu vijjati, app'assādā dukhā kāmā, iti viññāya paṇḍito.
idha vassaṃ vasissāmi, idha hem'antagimhisu, iti bālo vicinteti, antarāyaṃ na bujjhati.
adhivāsetu ca me bhavaṃ gotamo verañjāyaṃ vass'āvāsaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā'ti
dissat'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, cātumahābhūtiko kāyo ekam'pi vassaṃ tiṭṭhamāno dve'pi vassāni tiṭṭhamāno tīṇi'pi vassāni tiṭṭhamāno cattāri'pi vassāni tiṭṭhamāno
tiṭṭhe ce so tattha anānuyāyī, pūgam'pi vassānaṃ samantacakkhu, tatth'eva so sītisiyā vimutto, cavetha viññāṇaṃ tathāvidhassa.

66531.meaning1: (vinaya) years since monastic ordination; number of rains retreats completed

examples.text: kati vasso'si tvaṃ, bhikkhū'ti? ekavasso ahaṃ bhagavā'ti.

66532.meaning1: rains retreat; three-month long retreat for monastics
66532.meaning2: three month retreat for monastics; rains retreat
66532.commentary: (VINa) vassāne vassaṃ upagantun'ti vassānanāmake temāse vassaṃ upagantabban'ti attho.

examples.text: samayo'pi kho te, bhaddāli, appaṭividdho ahosi, sambahulā kho bhikkhu sāvatthiyaṃ vassaṃ upagatā, te'pi maṃ jānissanti, bhaddāli nāma bhikkhu satthusāsane sikkhāya aparipūrakārī'ti.

66533.meaning1: rite for rain; (comm) rite for virility
66533.commentary: (DNa) vassakammaṃ vossakamman'ti ettha vasso'ti puriso, vosso'ti paṇḍako. iti vossassa vassakaraṇaṃ vassakammaṃ, vassassa vossakaraṇaṃ vossakammaṃ. taṃ pana karonto acchandikabhāvamattaṃ pāpeti, na liṅgaṃ antaradhāpetuṃ sakkoti.

examples.text: te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti, seyyath'idaṃ, santikammaṃ paṇidhikammaṃ bhūtakammaṃ bhūrikammaṃ vassakammaṃ vossakammaṃ vatthukammaṃ vatthuparikammaṃ ācamanaṃ nhāpanaṃ juhanaṃ vamanaṃ virecanaṃ

66534.meaning1: name of a Brahman; Ajātasattu's chief minister

examples.text: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe. atha kho vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamah'āmatto yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
dhammo have rakkhati dhammacāriṃ, chattaṃ mahantaṃ viya vassakāle, dhammena gutto mama dhammapālo, aññassa aṭṭhīni sukhī kumāro'ti.

atha te bhikkhū kiṃ saṅghikaṃ amhākaṃ na pāpuṇātī'ti ghaṇṭiṃ paharitvā bhājāpetvā tesam'pi vass'aggena bhāgaṃ datvā attanā'pi paribhuñjiṃsu. tena nesaṃ bhagavā anāpatti, bhikkhave, paribhog'atthāyā'ti āha.

ubhatosaṅghassa ca tuyhañcā'ti vutte pana sace dasa bhikkhū ca dasa bhikkhuniyo ca honti, ekavīsati paṭivīse katvā eko puggalassa dātabbo, dasa bhikkhusaṅghassa, dasa bhikkhunisaṅghassa ca, yena puggaliko laddho, so saṅghato'pi attano vass'aggena gahetuṃ labhati, kasmā?
punappunañ'c'eva vapanti bījaṃ, punappunaṃ vassati devarājā, punappunaṃ khettaṃ kasanti kassakā, punappunaṃ dhaññam'upeti raṭṭhaṃ.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, uparipabbate thullaphusitake deve vassante taṃ udakaṃ yathāninnaṃ pavattamānaṃ pabbatakandarapadarasākhā paripūreti.
idāni, bhante, deve vassante deve gaḷagaḷāyante vijjullatāsu niccharantīsu asaniyā phalantiyā dve kassakā bhātaro hatā cattāro ca balibaddā.

66546.meaning1: name of two proponents of the doctrine of non-causality; Vassa and Bhañña
66546.commentary: (MNa) vassabhaññā'ti vasso ca bhañño cā'ti dve janā.

examples.text: ye'pi te, bhikkhave, ahesuṃ okkalā vassabhaññā ahetuvādā akiriyavādā n'atthikavādā te'pi mahācattārīsakaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ na garahitabbaṃ napaṭikkositabbaṃ amaññiṃsu.

66547.meaning1: name of two proponents of the doctrine of non-causality; Vassa and Bhiñña
66547.commentary: (SNa) vassabhaññā'ti vasso ca bhañño ca. dve'pi hi te mūladiṭṭhigatikā.

examples.text: ye'pi te paribbājakā ahesuṃ ukkalā vassabhiññā ahetukavādā akiriyavādā n'atthikavādā, te'pi imāni cattāri dhammapadāni na garahitabbaṃ na paṭikkositabbaṃ amaññiṃsu.
assuttha no tumhe, bhikkhave, rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ jarasiṅgālassa vassamānassā'ti

66549.meaning1: rainy months; months of the monsoon season
66549.meaning2: rainy months; months of the monsoon season

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, sāmuddikāya nāvāya vettabandhanabaddhāya vassamāsāni udake pariyādāya hem'antikena thalaṃ ukkhittāya vāt'ātapaparetāni vettabandhanāni.
tatr'assa kāṇo kacchapo. so vassasatassa vassasatassa accayena sakiṃ sakiṃ ummujjeyya.
appaṃ vata jīvitaṃ idaṃ, oraṃ vassasatā'pi miyyati, yo ce'pi aticca jīvati, atha kho so jarasā'pi miyyati.

66552.meaning1: living one hundred years; (comm) with one hundred years of life remaining

examples.text: so kho ahaṃ, bhante, aññatr'eva asitapītakhāyitasāyitā aññatra uccārapassāvakammā aññatra niddākilamathapaṭivinodanā vassasat'āyuko vassasatajīvī vassasataṃ gantvā appatvā'va lokassa antaṃ antarā'y'eva kālaṅ'kato.

66553.meaning1: with a life span of one hundred years at the most

examples.text: tatr'āssa kāṇo kacchapo, so vassasatassa vassasahassassa vassasatasahassassa accayena sakiṃ ummujjeyya.

66555.meaning1: living for one hundred years; with a life span of one hundred years; (comm) with one hundred years of life remaining
66555.commentary: (SNa) vassasat'āyuko'ti tadā dīgh'āyukakālo hoti, ayaṃ pana vassasat'āvasiṭṭhe āyumhi gamanaṃ ārabhi.

examples.text: so kho ahaṃ, bhante, aññatr'eva asitapītakhāyitasāyitā aññatra uccārapassāvakammā aññatra niddākilamathapaṭivinodanā vassasat'āyuko vassasatajīvī vassasataṃ gantvā appatvā'va lokassa antaṃ antarā'y'eva kālaṅ'kato.
idha me assu, sāriputta, cattāro sāvakā vassasat'āyukā vassasatajīvino, paramāya satiyā ca gatiyā ca dhitiyā ca samannāgatā paramena ca paññāveyyattiyena.
yato ca kho ayaṃ bhavaṃ puriso jiṇṇo hoti vuddho mahallako addhagato vayoanuppatto, āsītiko vā nāvutiko vā vassasatiko vā jātiyā, atha tamhā paññāveyyattiyā, parihāyatī'ti.

idha, bhikkhave, tam'eva bhaginiṃ passeyya aparena samayena āsītikaṃ vā nāvutikaṃ vā vassasatikaṃ vā jātiyā, jiṇṇaṃ gopānasivaṅkaṃ bhoggaṃ daṇḍaparāyanaṃ pavedhamānaṃ gacchantiṃ āturaṃ gatayobbanaṃ khaṇḍadantaṃ palitakesaṃ, vilūnaṃ khalitasiraṃ valinaṃ tilak'āhatagattaṃ.

vassasat'ūpasampannāya bhikkhuniyā tadah'upasampannassa bhikkhuno abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjalikammaṃ sāmīcikammaṃ kātabbaṃ, ayam'pi dhammo sakkatvā garukatvā mānetvā pūjetvā yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyo.
atha kho maṃ, pāpima, nirayapālā upasaṅkamitvā etadavocuṃ, yadā kho te, mārisa, saṅkunā saṅku hadaye samāgaccheyya, atha naṃ tvaṃ jāneyyāsi, vassasahassaṃ me niraye paccamānassā'ti.
koṇāgamanassa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa tiṃsavassasahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi. kassapassa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa vīsativassasahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi.

66559.meaning1: living for one thousand years; with a lifespan of one thousand years

examples.text: tesaṃ āyunā'pi parihāyamānānaṃ vaṇṇena'pi parihāyamānānaṃ aḍḍhateyyavassasahass'āyukānaṃ manussānaṃ vassasahass'āyukā puttā ahesuṃ.
vessabhussa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa suppatito nāma rājā pitā ahosi. vassavatī nāma devī mātā ahosi janetti. suppatitassa rañño anomaṃ nāma nagaraṃ rājadhānī ahosi.

66563.meaning1: of the rain clouds; (comm) who makes rain clouds

examples.text: katame ca, bhikkhave, valāhakakāyikā devā? santi, bhikkhave, sītavalāhakā devā, santi uṇhavalāhakā devā, santi abbhavalāhakā devā, santi vātavalāhakā devā, santi vassavalāhakā devā, ime vuccanti, bhikkhave, valāhakakāyikā devā'ti.

66564.meaningLit: discourse on (deities living in) rain clouds

66566.meaning1: who had spent the rains retreat; who had completed the rains (in)

examples.text: atha kho sambahulā jātibhūmakā bhikkhū jātibhūmiyaṃ vassaṃvuṭṭhā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhuniyo gāmak'āvāse vassaṃvuṭṭhā sāvatthiṃ agamaṃsu vattasampannā iriyāpathasampannā duccoḷā lūkhacīvarā.

66567.meaning1: who had spent the rains retreat; who had completed the rains (in)
66567.commentary: (VINa) vassaṃvutthā'ti purimikāya upagatā mahāpavāraṇāya pavāritā pāṭipadadivasato paṭṭhāya vutthavassā'ti vuccanti. evaṃ vassaṃvutthā hutvā.

examples.text: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu rājagahe vassaṃvuttho yena dakkhiṇāgiri yen'āyasmā sāriputto ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā sāriputtena saddhiṃ sammodi.

66568.meaningLit: discourse on completed the rains retreat

66569.notes: (PED) orig. gen. pl. of vassa = vassānaṃ, fr. combination vassāna(ṃ) māse, in a month of raining

examples.text: tatth'āyaṃ samayo diyaḍḍho māso seso gimhānan'ti vassānassa paṭhamo māso icc'ete aḍḍhateyyamāsā uṇhasamayo, pariḷāhasamayo, gilānasamayo, kammasamayo, addhānagamanasamayo, vātavuṭṭhisamayo
utun'idha pana sāsane hem'anta-gimha-vassānānaṃ vassena tīṇi honti.
examples.source: VIN PAT PK saṅghuposatha pubbakaraṇādi vidhi

examples.text: ayaṃ vassāno'tu, asmiñ'ca utumhi aṭṭha uposathā, iminā pakkhena eko uposatho sampatto, eko uposathā atikkantā, cha uposathā avasiṭṭhā.

66574.meaning1: having made it rain; having caused a downpour (of)

examples.text: imasmiṃ kira jātake bodhisatto koṇḍadamako ahosi. so ten'eva paratantiyuttabhāvena jīvitakkhayaṃ pāpuṇi. devatā kujjhitvā sakalam'eva majjharaṭṭhaṃ uṇhaṃ kukkuḷavassaṃ vassāpetvā raṭṭhaṃ araṭṭham'akaṃsu.

te upakaṭṭhāya vass'ūpanāyikāya pañcasatatāpase himavantato āgantvā nagare bhikkhāya carante disvā pasīditvā nisīdāpetvā bhojetvā paṭiññaṃ gahetvā cattāro māse attano santike vasāpetvā puna vassāratte āgaman'atthāya paṭijānāpetvā uyyojesuṃ.

66577.meaning1: time of the rains retreat; residence for the rainy season

examples.text: tena hi tvaṃ anuruddha āyatikam'pi vass'āvāsaṃ idh'eva cetīsu pācīnavaṃsadāye vihareyyāsī'ti
ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sāriputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, vuttho me, bhante, sāvatthiyaṃ vass'āvāso. icchām'ahaṃ, bhante, janapadacārikaṃ pakkamitun'ti.

66578.meaning1: something for the rains retreat; gift for the rains retreat

examples.text: so ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya, āgacchantu bhadantā vass'āvāsikaṃ dassāmī'ti, etaṃ accekacīvaraṃ nāma.

evam'etesu ekādasasu janesu kurudhammaṃ rakkhantesu kaliṅgaraṭṭhe dantapuranagare kaliṅge rajjaṃ kārente tasmiṃ raṭṭhe devo na vassi. mahāsattassa pana añjanasannibho nāma maṅgalahatthī mahāpuñño hoti.

66581.meaning1: related to the rainy season; for the monsoon

examples.text: atha kho, bhikkhave, bandhumā rājā vipassissa kumārassa tayo pāsāde kārāpesi, ekaṃ vassikaṃ ekaṃ hem'antikaṃ ekaṃ gimhikaṃ, pañca kāmaguṇāni upaṭṭhāpesi
tena kho pana samayena bārāṇasiyaṃ yaso nāma kulaputto seṭṭhiputto sukhumālo hoti. tassa tayo pāsādā honti, eko hem'antiko, eko gimhiko, eko vassiko.
yadā navo pabbajito, jātiyā sattavassiko, iddhiyā abhibhotvāna, pannag'indaṃ mah'iddhikaṃ.
tena kho pana samayena rājagahakassa seṭṭhissa sattavassiko sīs'ābādho hoti. bahū mahantā mahantā disāpāmokkhā vejjā āgantvā n'āsakkhiṃsu arogaṃ kātuṃ.
seyyathā'pi, āvuso, itthī vā puriso vā daharo yuvā maṇḍanakajātiko sīsaṃnhāto uppalamālaṃ vā vassikamālaṃ vā atimuttakamālaṃ vā labhitvā ubhohi hatthehi paṭiggahetvā uttam'aṅge sirasmiṃ patiṭṭhapeyya
māso seso gimhānan'ti, bhikkhunā vassikasāṭikacīvaraṃ pariyesitabbaṃ, addhamāso seso gimhānan'ti katvā nivāsetabbaṃ.
ye manussā pubbe'pi vassikasāṭikacīvaraṃ denti te upasaṅkamitvā evam'assu vacanīyā, kālo vassikasāṭikāya, samayo vassikasāṭikāya, aññe'pi manussā vassikasāṭikacīvaraṃ dentī'ti.

66587.meaning2: kind of rain coat used by Buddhist monks during the rainy season

examples.text: ye manussā pubbe'pi vassikasāṭikacīvaraṃ denti te upasaṅkamitvā evam'assu vacanīyā, kālo vassikasāṭikāya, samayo vassikasāṭikāya, aññe'pi manussā vassikasāṭikacīvaraṃ dentī'ti.
vassikasāṭikaṃ pana bhikkhunā kārayamānena pamāṇikā kāretabbā, tatr'idaṃ pamāṇaṃ, dīghaso cha vidatthiyo sugatavidatthiyā, tiriyaṃ aḍḍhateyyā. taṃ atikkāmayato chedanakaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
vassikā viya pupphāni, maddavāni pamuñcati, evaṃ rāgañ'ca dosañ'ca, vippamuñcetha bhikkhavo.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, ye keci pupphagandhā, vassikaṃ tesaṃ aggam'akkhāyati, evam'evaṃ kho bhikkhave, ye keci kusalā dhammā, sabbe te appamādamūlakā appamādasamosaraṇā, appamādo tesaṃ aggam'akkhāyati.
candanaṃ tagaraṃ vā'pi, uppalaṃ atha vassikī, etesaṃ gandhajātānaṃ, sīlagandho anuttaro.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, khattiyakaññā vā brāhmaṇakaññā vā gahapatikaññā vā pannarasavass'uddesikā vā soḷasavass'uddesikā vā, n'ātidīghā n'ātirassā n'ātikisā n'ātithūlā n'ātikāḷī n'āccodātā paramā sā, bhikkhave, tasmiṃ samaye subhā vaṇṇanibhā'ti?

66596.meaning1: entered the rains retreat; spending the rainy season

examples.text: anāpatti vass'upagatā bhikkhū pakkantā vā honti vibbhantā vā kālaṅ'katā vā pakkhasaṅkantā vā, āpadāsu, ummattikāya, ādikammikāyā'ti.

66597.meaning1: entered the rains retreat; spending the rainy season

examples.text: aññatarasmiṃ āvāse vass'ūpagatānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ gāmo corehi vuṭṭhāsi.
atha kho bhagavato vass'ūpagatassa kharo ābādho uppajji, bāḷhā vedanā vattanti māraṇ'antikā.
purimāni, bhante, divasāni purimatarāni tadah'uposathe pannarase vass'ūpanāyikāya puṇṇāya puṇṇamāya rattiyā kevalakappā ca devā tāvatiṃsā sudhammāyaṃ sabhāyaṃ sannisinnā honti sannipatitā.
